key_insight: Cost-aware abstention cut TF-IDF logistic regression’s held-out routing cost by 38.1% and wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5% under illustrative costs.
engineering_relevance: Select routing thresholds using explicit error and human-triage costs, then validate the frozen policy before automating IT ticket routing.
method: Compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four LLMs using zero- and few-shot prompts.
Select abstention policies on calibration data and evaluate once on held-out test data.
Assess confidence using ECE, correctness AUROC, and tie-aware risk-coverage area.
evidence_signal: On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, a calibration-selected threshold of 0.60 reduced logistic regression’s test cost from 0.763 to 0.472 (38.1% reduction; 95% CI: 35.7%–40.4%).
watch_item: Results depend on the dataset, prompts, model endpoints, and assumed costs; improved calibration alone does not ensure useful error discrimination.
paper_title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
